The rotation matrix by $360^\circ$ around the $z$-axis is the identity matrix:
\[ \mathbf{A}^{2018} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}. \]
